selection.ranking: Ascending SHA256(UTF8(decimal_seed + verticalbar + source_key + verticalbar + source_id)); tie break source_id. Seed20261104. No tokenizer/model/answer-based selection.
selection.openbookqa_source_id: Publisher id string; duplicates or empty ids fail integrity checks.
selection.boolq_source_id: Canonical decimal zero-based pinned validation Parquet row index; HFschema has no publisher id field. It is a source-row id, not a claimed original Google id.
selection.openbookqa_eligibility: Nonempty string question_stem; exactly4nonempty string choices with4distinct nonempty labels. No length truncation or answerKey inspection.
selection.boolq_eligibility: Nonempty string passage and question. Full text preserved; no length, difficulty, answer or model-based filter.
selection.openbookqa_render: question_stem.strip()+LF+source-order label.strip()+dot+space+choice_text.strip(), LF-separated, final LF. No facts, answer or answer cue added.
selection.boolq_render: Literal Passage: +LF+passage.strip()+LF+LF+literal Question: +LF+question.strip()+LF. No answer or answer cue added.
selection.item_order: OpenBookQA ranks00..07, then BoolQ ranks00..07, same16prompt bytes supplied to both G4andDeep.
selection.failures: Fewer than8eligible, duplicate ids, duplicate selected prompts or invalid selected answers fail; do not relax/resample.
selection.answers: Read answer columns only after chosen row indices are fixed. Store labels/booleans in answers/answers.json; never append them to prompts.
